biggest_catch: Only clients with no existing or prior Dedham Savings personal checking account qualify, and the direct deposit must hit the account on at least a monthly basis throughout the 90-day window — not just total the threshold.
catches: Available only to clients who do not have an existing or prior personal checking account at Dedham Savings.
Open a Free & Easy Checking account in person at any Dedham Savings location or online with promo code 'SELECT.'

Within 90 calendar days of account opening: (1) receive recurring direct deposits totaling $2,500+ ($250 bonus), $10,000+ ($500 bonus), or $20,000+ ($750 bonus); AND (2) complete 5+ debit card transactions totaling $100+ OR 5+ Bill Pay transactions totaling $100+.
Direct deposit must be recurring and deposited into the account on at least a monthly basis throughout the 90-day period.
Qualifying direct deposit = recurring deposit of a paycheck, pension, Social Security, or other regular monthly income, electronically deposited by an employer or outside agency.

Excluded: person-to-person payments, self-initiated transfers between accounts at Dedham Savings and other institutions or brokerages (including pension accounts), and payments through third parties such as PayPal or eBay.
No minimum balance is required to earn the bonus; one offer per client.
Bonus is deposited to the checking account within 90 days after qualifications are met and will be reported to the IRS for tax reporting purposes.
Minimum $25 deposit to open the account; $50 opening deposit to receive a debit card.
